description: The modes of the egress audit. browser turns the browser leg on for a product that names a web_service: negative (no DNS query, connection attempt, HAR entry or DOM reference to a never-allowed host from the browser) or positive (the same, and the browser must make the product's ui_expected_requests of the mode).env values are set on every product service (with the product's env prefix); null means unset; __MOCK_URL__ is the mock platform's address (http on a fixed private address of the sealed network, which the SDK accepts as local) and __MOCK_ISSUER__ the https issuer its documents name, which the product passes to the SDK as its issuer. A positive mode starts the mock platform and lists the outbound-call rows the product must make (required_rows) and may make (allowed_rows); "generated" means every row of the outbound-call table that applies to the product.

off.description: Both modules switched off: no module route, no call, no DNS query for any Ever host.

loaded_off.description: Modules loaded but idle: statistics switched off in the operator settings, the connection module enabled but not connected. No request before an operator acts.

positive_stats.description: Statistics on against the mock platform: at least one signed, schema-valid report, nothing else.

positive_connect.description: The connection module on with a mock connect code: exactly the key manifest, redeem, token, heartbeat, events, entitlement and integration states.

every_trigger.description: Both modules on and every trigger exercised by the adapter: the call log must equal the generated outbound-call list of the product, row for row.

positive_managed.description: A managed operation requested on the feed: after the request, only the feed read and the result call.
